'''Formulation Bench''' is a {{Mastery|Violet}} [[Workstation|workstation]] that can be built in the [[Writing Room]] and in the [[Alchemy Lab]].

Here, the Keeper can craft candles for the [[church]], fertilizers for the [[garden]], injections for upgrade [[corpses]] and other items.
